title: Fasteners
description: Standard/custom threaded parts, small sizes, various head types (hex/socket/flat)
designPrinciples: Material: Grade 9 (Ti-3Al-2.5V) is standard for aerospace fasteners. Lower strength than TC4 but better cold heading formability. Grade 5 for high-strength bolts.
Form: Wire/small bar is the standard form for fasteners. Direct cold/hot heading, material utilization >95%.
comparisonNotes: Standards: AMS 4934 / ASTM B348 Gr9, solution+aged (STA), 100% thread inspection
